name: Runner Extras - TestPage action invoke
brief: Proves TestPage.<Action>.Invoke() runs the page's OnAction trigger, in the page's own context, and propagates errors it raises.
description: MockITestAction.Invoke() was a literal no-op, so every TestPage action silently did nothing and any assertion about its effect failed a step later with a message about the effect rather than about the action. The negatives are the point: an OnAction that raises an Error must surface that error rather than have it swallowed (a swallowed error turns a failing test green), and invoking one action must not run another's trigger, which is what a lookup that matched actions loosely would do.
